<STBG 3,0><BGM 0,0,502><TALK 1><NAME 1><CHAR 5,1,7,0,0><CHAR 1,1,1,2,0><CV 1,5>Dr. Andra!
I found something suspicious,
so I took a photograph!

This is a cave...
But the inside is very bright...

Hmm, this is...
There seem to be holes letting light in
beyond — and many of them...

This might be a passage running
beneath the whole island.

A Web Gallery, one might call it.
This is a new discovery!

<TALK 1><NAME 1><CV 1,10><CHAR 1,0,1,3,0>We did it, Hunter!
A great discovery!
